_comment: Damage reflection, design step 2. Chain Reaction deals X to each creature, X = the number of
creatures on the battlefield AS IT RESOLVES, both sides: Mogg Maniac + Screaming Nemesis + five
opponent Spirits = 7. Both reflectors are dealt 7 and die, and both reflections resolve (LKI):
7 + 7 = 14 = the opponent's life. Counting only our own creatures (X = 2) would deal 4, and
attacking instead deals 4, so the T4 win needs the opponent's Spirits counted in X.
